title: Physical Masked Reviewer Media Preflight, Custody and Panel Activation Boundary
transparency: BEFORE_THIS_PREREG the investigator downloaded original V3-61 artifact, inspected ZIP metadata, verified each video SHA-256 and codec using ffprobe, and visually previewed four timestamped frames per video. These observations are exploratory, NOT prospective evidence; no inferential claims or blinded reviewer scores.

protocol.native_decode: Run ffmpeg -xerror decode of all frames for each exact hash-matched MP4; verify H264/AAC 1280x720 15fps, same video frames, AAC packet SHA per topic.
protocol.kit_integrity: Exactly 16 files; 9 media + 3 HTML + JS/CSS + START_HERE + MASKED_MANIFEST; reject unexpected executable or admin files; verify manifest and all 9 movie SHA-256 with original V3-60 prereg.
protocol.visual_preflight: Descriptive, no human scores. Capture 4 sample timestamps per video at fractions [0.12, 0.34, 0.58, 0.82] and annotate separately without inspecting treatment assignment. Systematic 1fps change summaries on the visible teaching canvas exclude lower subtitle and UI strips; report as pixel-only proxy, not comprehension.
protocol.distribution: Preserve original masked-only artifact unaltered for external reviewers. Document one form per reviewer, separate admin key, private original consent/custody and V3-70 local score-lock path. No emails or outreach without approved recipient identities.
protocol.scientific_gates: No reviewer panel exists currently; V3-60 independent score analysis remains blocked regardless of technical results. Static arm confounds motion and early result exposure.

acceptance: Exact existing frozen nine native video SHA256 match; full nine-video decode and within-topic AAC/frame parity; manifest treatment mapping withheld.
Systematic audit receipt and blinded contact sheets generated only from unchanged MP4s; optional pixel proxy explicitly labeled not a human score.
Original first-party preflight kit downloadable and kept separate from admin mapping; no video edits or fabricated consent/reviews.
No changes to old V3-60/61/70 registrations, outcome thresholds, locked source videos or original V3-64 API status.
Dedicated self-contained offline negative tests where possible, do not add broad job-fanout; never model/provider API or secret access.
Update canonical PLAN_V3/Research Notes and report fail-closed limitations; report actual CI status only after verified.
